head: 8e82d779773981afd4339394136b5218c2a7f9d6
claim: an app can start one local, token-protected NATS JetStream server from a hash-checked pinned download, publish to a durable stream and read it with explicit acks, and shut down without a hung process

steps: start a local, token-protected NATS JetStream server with ensureNats from the pinned, hash-checked download and check health
publish a message twice to a durable stream with one id
read it with an explicit ack reader that naks once then acks
close the bus and start ensureNats again on the same folder: only the unacked message is read
shut down a bus holding a reader whose handler never settles, without a hung process, then stop the server
steps.result: an app can run a local, token-protected NATS JetStream server, publish to a durable stream, read with explicit acks, and shut down without a hung process

verdicts.seen: Read 7 capture lines. Start: 'started true nats://127.0.0.1:32847 health true' with a store path. Replay: 'duplicate true' and 'seen [["one",1],["one",2]]'. Resume: 'started false same url true' and 'only unacked ["two"]'. Clean exit: 'close returned in ms 5004', then 'stop: health false' and 'EXIT=0'. This matches the outcome: local server start, durable publish and read, ack-based resume, and shutdown without a hang. Not shown: token protection and the hash-checked download. Other captures may cover those parts. The 5004 ms close is slow but it returned and the process exited with 0, so it does not contradict the outcome.
